title: StandupDrawer: profile-aware window defaults (no override masking)
description: Console StandupDrawer should default window/skip_weekends to meeting-script profile values (calendar + skip_weekends true). Do not always send window/lookback/skip_weekends in POST body when unchanged — omit overrides so profile defaults apply.
right_now_summary: The drawer should use profile defaults and omit unchanged window overrides from POST requests.
